corrections.problem: The second bonus is attached to targetKind 'perception'. The record's own text is: "you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and to your Perception DC for 10 minutes". A Perception DC is the number OTHERS roll against — it is never added to any Perception check you make. Putting it on the perception target makes the sheet star Perception and tell the player they have a bonus on a roll that in fact gets nothing. That is the exact 'misleading marker' failure the brief warns about, and needsEngineWork alone does not neutralise it because the marker still renders on the wrong stat.
corrections.correction: Keep only the Diplomacy entry: { bonus: '+1 item', when: 'for 10 minutes after you drink it (1 hour if brewed with the Tea Ceremony), to Diplomacy checks', target: { kind: 'skill', skill: 'diplomacy' } }. Drop the perception entry from the registry and record the Perception-DC clause as needsEngineWork prose only (the app has no Perception DC stat), or set needsHumanDecision asking the owner whether a Perception DC display should be added. Everything else in this spec (situational true, +1 item, durations 10 minutes / 1 hour with the Tea Ceremony) is confirmed correct.

corrections.problem: Low severity, but unflagged: the condition 'while in mountainous terrain' is stated as an ONGOING requirement with confidence 'high'. The record's text reads "For the listed duration, drinking this elixir while in mountainous terrain protects you from the effects of severe cold and grants you an item bonus to Athletics checks made to Climb, High Jump, or Long Jump" — grammatically the terrain qualifies the act of DRINKING, not the whole duration. Under the printed wording, drinking it in the Kodars and then descending arguably keeps the bonus; under the spec's wording it is lost. The same sentence (and the same spec wording) appears verbatim in moderate-elixir-of-the-peaks, greater-elixir-of-the-peaks and major-elixir-of-the-peaks, so the same correction applies to all four.
corrections.correction: Either phrase the condition to mirror the text — when: 'for 1 hour after drinking it in mountainous terrain, to Athletics checks to Climb, High Jump, or Long Jump' — or keep the current wording but drop confidence to medium and set needsHumanDecision: 'Does the mountainous-terrain clause gate only the moment of drinking, or the whole duration?'. Everything else in the four elixir specs is confirmed against the record: +1/1 hour (lesser), +2/one day (moderate), +3/1 day (greater), +3/7 days (major), item type, Athletics target, and the high-altitude save clause with no printed save type.

The spec's own reasonIfNot concedes this, and it marked Battle Lute — identical wording — situational, so the chunk is internally inconsistent.

corrections.correction: Fortitude entry when = "to your Fortitude DC against attempts to Reposition or Shove you, and to Fortitude saves against effects that would force you to move or knock you prone"; Reflex entry when = "to your Reflex DC against attempts to Trip you, and to Reflex saves against effects that would force you to move or knock you prone".

name: Enhanced Hearing Aids

currentBonuses.when: on hearing-based Perception checks, for 10 minutes after you Activate the aids (once per day, and only while your hearing aids are on)

evidence: "You mentally increase the input of your hearing aids. You gain a +1 item bonus to all hearing-based Perception checks for 10 minutes."

corrections.problem: The engineNote asserts an importer defect: "the record's activationCost is stored as 'free' although the description prints a reaction-style '⟨4⟩ envision' activation". That is false. In this app ⟨4⟩ IS the free-action glyph — src/sheet/widgets.tsx, ActionGlyph: case 'free' returns <Glyph char="4" title="Free action" /> and case 'reaction' returns char="5". So activationCost {type:'free'} matches the printed ⟨4⟩ exactly; there is nothing to raise with the importer, and the note would send someone chasing a non-bug (the same ⟨4⟩/free pairing appears on cleft-head-marking-* and fate-tempters-ring, and ⟨5⟩/reaction on the flowing-water tattoos, all consistent).
corrections.correction: Drop the engineNote's importer claim. The bonus classification itself is correct and should stand as authored: +1 item, targetKind 'perception', when = "on hearing-based Perception checks, for 10 minutes after you Activate the aids (free action, once per day; requires your hearing aids to be currently on)".

name: Dawnfire Beacon (Major)

currentBonuses.when: against unholy effects, while you are inside the banner's aura

evidence: "This magical banner also grants a +1 status bonus to saving throws against unholy effects to all creatures within the banner's aura."

corrections.problem: The engineNote says "the aura's radius is not stated in this record (it is a property of the banner the beacon is attached to)". Both halves are wrong. The record's own first line is "The warm, caring light of the sun glows from the center of this magical banner" — the Dawnfire Beacon IS the banner; its usage is 'affixed-or-held-in-one-hand', i.e. affixed to a WEAPON or held, never attached to some other banner. And the radius is knowable: the Foundry record models it as an Aura rule element with radius 30 (the standard Battlecry! banner aura). The condition also drops a requirement the record does print: "This effect is suppressed when you aren't holding the banner or wielding the weapon it is affixed to."
corrections.correction: Keep the entry (+1 status, targetKind 'save', save 'all') and keep needsEngineWork true for the ally/aura gap only. Rewrite the condition to "against unholy effects, while you're holding the banner (or wielding the weapon it's affixed to) and within its 30-foot aura", and replace the engineNote's radius claim with: radius is 30 feet per the banner aura. Flag needsHumanDecision on one point the text leaves genuinely ambiguous: the suppression sentence grammatically attaches to the LIGHT paragraph, and Foundry's Aura carries no holding predicate — so whether the save bonus is also suppressed when the banner isn't held is the owner's call.

name: Ghast Stiletto

currentBonuses.when: against paralysis, while wielding the ghast stiletto

evidence: "While you wield the dagger, you gain a +1 status bonus to all saves against Paralysis."

corrections.problem: The engineNote claims the activation's "-2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from sickened" "falls on creatures caught in the emanation (enemies), not on you — do not author it as a penalty on the wielder". The record does not say that. Its text is "the target creature, as well as any creatures within a [emanation], must succeed at a save... While within the emanation, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition" — any creature, with no ally/enemy carve-out. core.json has dropped the emanation size (the text reads "within a , must succeed"); the Foundry source gives @Template[emanation|distance:10], a 10-foot emanation centred on the creature you just stabbed — which a melee wielder of a 10-ft-thrown dagger is normally standing inside. The stated reason for omitting it is therefore invalid.
corrections.correction: Keep the +1 status save-vs-paralysis entry as authored. Either add a second entry — bonus "-2 circumstance (penalty)", targetKind 'save', save 'all', when "on saves against disease and to recover from sickened, while you're within 10 feet of a creature struck by the activated ghast stiletto (1 minute)" — matching how the earplugs and feather-of-unfounded-bravado specs already carry penalties, or omit it and say so honestly ("self-inflicted edge case, owner chose not to surface it"). Also note as a data defect that the emanation distance is missing from the core.json description.

name: Dream Hunter's Lodge

currentBonuses.when: on the NEXT Recall Knowledge check about a creature with the dream trait within 24 hours, after spending 10 minutes studying the lodge's trophies

evidence: "If a creature inside the lodge spends 10 minutes studying these trophies, they gain a +3 item bonus to the next skill check they make in the next 24 hours to Recall Knowledge about any creature with the dream trait."

corrections.problem: needsEngineWork is left false while the engineNote itself lists two things the app cannot represent: "it is a ONE-SHOT bonus consumed by the next qualifying check, and it also benefits every other creature inside the lodge (allies)". The ally-facing half is exactly the reason the spec-writer set needsEngineWork true on dawnfire-beacon-major, so the two records are flagged inconsistently — and the one-shot-consumption behaviour is a gap no other entry in this chunk has, since a starred stat would keep advertising a +3 that was already spent.
corrections.correction: Set needsEngineWork true. Bonus/target/condition as authored (+3 item, targetKind 'skill', skill 'all', "on the NEXT Recall Knowledge check about a creature with the dream trait within 24 hours, after spending 10 minutes studying the lodge's trophies"). Missing engine support: (a) one-shot bonuses that are consumed by the next qualifying check, and (b) bonuses that also apply to other party members' sheets.

name: Commandant's Scabbard

currentBonuses.when: for 1 round after you draw that weapon from the commandant's scabbard (one melee weapon of 1 Bulk or lighter)

evidence: "Whenever a weapon is drawn from the scabbard, it gains a +4 status bonus to damage for 1 round."

corrections.problem: needsEngineWork is left false (absent) although the engineNote states the blocking gap outright: "The +4 status damage applies only to the specific weapon sheathed in the scabbard, which the app does not track per-weapon." The clay-sphere specs set needsEngineWork true for the same class of problem (a bonus that depends on which item the gear is attached to), so this record is flagged inconsistently and the gap would be lost when the flags are triaged.
corrections.correction: Set needsEngineWork true. The entry itself is right and should stand (+4 status, targetKind 'strikeDamage', "for 1 round after you draw that weapon from the commandant's scabbard (one melee weapon of 1 Bulk or lighter)"), as is the call to leave the +3 item Athletics and the apex Strength out of the registry — both are confirmed present as passiveEffects.skills.athletics = 3 and apexAttribute 'str'. Missing engine support: recording which single weapon is sheathed in the scabbard so the marker lands on that weapon's strike only.

name: Close Ties

currentBonuses.when: only if you took the Bickering family adjustment: until the end of your next turn after you witness your sibling PC critically fail a significant skill check or attack roll

evidence: Base background grants no typed bonus (Diplomacy, Tea Lore, Specialty Crafting, friendly NPC). The only typed bonus in the record is the shared adjustment block: "**Bickering:** ... Whenever your sibling(s) critically fail a significant skill check or attack roll and you witness their failure, you gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws until the end of your next turn"

corrections.problem: Emits a +1 status bonus to all saves that the background does not grant. The bonus comes from the 'Bickering' option inside the Family adjustment block, and that block's own opening line in the record is "You can add one of the following two adjustments to ANY background" — it is opt-in, it replaces the background's skill feat, and it is available to every background, not these four. The same boilerplate is byte-identical in folklore-enthusiast, northridge-scholar and outskirt-dweller (I diffed all four). Writing it into the registry under a background id would star Fortitude/Reflex/Will for every character who picked one of these four backgrounds, including the overwhelming majority who never took the Family adjustment — a permanent false positive. It also triggers on ANOTHER PC's critical failure, which nothing in the app can observe. The spec author identified all of this in the engineNote and then emitted the bonus anyway.
corrections.correction: For all four Willowshore backgrounds (close-ties, folklore-enthusiast, northridge-scholar, outskirt-dweller): set bonuses to an empty array, situational:false with reasonIfNot 'the background itself grants no typed bonus', and keep needsHumanDecision:true. Bickering's +1 status to saves (and Close-Knit's DC-5 reduction) belong to a separate opt-in 'background adjustment' choice available to any background, not to these four ids.
